title: NPC spawns
description: field/npc_spawns.yaml: the NPCs the MAPHEAD section of each map puts on it as the map is entered (set_digimon), with what the path to each takes (dwx, formats::script::findMapHeadSpawns; docs/architecture/script-warps.md). Co-op reads it to show at once the NPCs another player's story change brings or takes away. Mods override the whole document.

condition.description: An IF entry as the script listing writes it: test, clear, compare, combine and the operands.

guard.description: The decisions of the path, in order: each IF's tests and the result they must give, or the arm of a SWITCH or SET_SELECTION. unstructured: the path goes round a loop or a state machine, so these are the terms of one way through.

items.description: An IF term (if and holds), a choice term (switch or selection: the arm), a recursion the walk cut (recursion) or an instruction that runs game code which writes triggers (forget).

forget.description: An instruction that runs game code which may set or clear triggers (call_routine, call_digimon_routine, give_item, compare_date): the path goes on not knowing them. Its script and offset, and the triggers by number; none listed: any trigger.

recursion.description: A call of a routine the walk was already in: the walk does not follow it again, and the path goes on after the call knowing no trigger. The routine's script and offset.

map.description: The map the section loads the script of (or the number of a map without an id).

slot.description: The map's NPC record the spawn puts on the map.

species.description: The species the spawn names (the record's must be the same).

autotalk.description: Whether touching the NPC runs its section without confirm.

section_writes.description: The variables the guard tests that the section writes itself (not the clock of store_date): their tests are unknown later.

source.description: Where the spawn is: MAPHEAD's script number, the section and the offset.
